windowsDesktop.scenario: private inactive Windows desktop, separate ordinary window kept intact

limits: These results count actual windows in controlled sequential task fixtures, not memory usage or Edge process count.
Four retained results are explicitly requested open in the fixture; they remain as four tabs while the candidate uses one task window.
Unknown windows from older builds cannot be safely attributed from title or URL and were not bulk-closed.
Real daily installation and loaded-runtime verification are separate from isolated acceptance.
The earlier no-ordinary-window cold-start anomaly remains documented in the .11 evidence; it is not claimed fixed by this change.
